name: 23 - API - Offer Free Slot to Waitlist - Standalone Final

nodes.name: Webhook - Offer Free Slot to Waitlist

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::TEXT AS clinic_name,
        $2::TEXT AS doctor_name,
        $3::TEXT AS service_name,
        $4::DATE AS target_date,
        $5::TIME AS start_time,
        LEAST(
            GREATEST($6::INTEGER, 5),
            1440
        ) AS offer_expiry_minutes,
        $7::TEXT AS source
),

expired_offers AS (
    UPDATE appointment_waitlist_offers offer

    SET
        status = 'expired',
        responded_at = COALESCE(
            offer.responded_at,
            NOW()
        ),
        updated_at = NOW()

    WHERE offer.status = 'offered'
      AND offer.expires_at <= NOW()

    RETURNING
        offer.waitlist_id
),

reactivated_waitlists AS (
    UPDATE appointment_waitlist waitlist

    SET
        status = 'active',
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM expired_offers expired

    WHERE waitlist.id = expired.waitlist_id
      AND waitlist.status = 'offered'

      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM appointment_waitlist_offers active_offer

          WHERE active_offer.waitlist_id = waitlist.id
            AND active_offer.status = 'offered'
            AND active_offer.expires_at > NOW()
      )

    RETURNING waitlist.id
),

expiry_barrier AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS reactivated_count
    FROM reactivated_waitlists
),

slot_context AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS clinic_id,
        c.name AS clinic_name,
        c.timezone,

        d.id AS doctor_id,
        d.full_name AS doctor_name,
        d.buffer_minutes,

        s.id AS service_id,
        s.name AS service_name,
        s.duration_minutes,

        r.target_date,
        r.start_time,
        r.offer_expiry_minutes,
        r.source,

        slot.slot_start_local
            AT TIME ZONE c.timezone
            AS offered_starts_at,

        (
            slot.slot_start_local
            + MAKE_INTERVAL(
                mins => s.duration_minutes
            )
        ) AT TIME ZONE c.timezone
            AS offered_ends_at

    FROM request_data r

    CROSS JOIN expiry_barrier barrier

    INNER JOIN clinics c
        ON c.name = r.clinic_name
       AND c.is_active = TRUE

    INNER JOIN doctors d
        ON d.clinic_id = c.id
       AND d.full_name = r.doctor_name
       AND d.is_active = TRUE

    INNER JOIN services s
        ON s.clinic_id = c.id
       AND s.name = r.service_name
       AND s.is_active = TRUE

    INNER JOIN doctor_schedules ds
        ON ds.doctor_id = d.id
       AND ds.is_active = TRUE

       AND ds.weekday =
            EXTRACT(
                ISODOW FROM r.target_date
            )::INTEGER

       AND (
            ds.valid_from IS NULL
            OR ds.valid_from <= r.target_date
       )

       AND (
            ds.valid_to IS NULL
            OR ds.valid_to >= r.target_date
       )

    CROSS JOIN LATERAL GENERATE_SERIES(
        r.target_date + ds.start_time,

        r.target_date
            + ds.end_time
            - MAKE_INTERVAL(
                mins => s.duration_minutes
            ),

        MAKE_INTERVAL(
            mins =>
                s.duration_minutes
                + d.buffer_minutes
        )
    ) AS slot(slot_start_local)

    WHERE slot.slot_start_local =
          r.target_date + r.start_time

    LIMIT 1
),

slot_state AS (
    SELECT
        sc.*,

        (
            sc.offered_starts_at <= NOW()
        ) AS is_in_past,

        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM schedule_exceptions se

            WHERE se.doctor_id = sc.doctor_id
              AND se.is_active = TRUE
              AND se.exception_type = 'unavailable'

              AND se.starts_at <
                    sc.offered_ends_at

              AND se.ends_at >
                    sc.offered_starts_at
        ) AS is_blocked,

        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM appointments existing

            WHERE existing.doctor_id =
                  sc.doctor_id

              AND existing.status IN (
                  'pending',
                  'confirmed'
              )

              AND existing.starts_at <
                    sc.offered_ends_at

              AND existing.ends_at >
                    sc.offered_starts_at
        ) AS has_appointment_conflict,

        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM appointment_waitlist_offers existing_offer

            WHERE existing_offer.doctor_id =
                  sc.doctor_id

              AND existing_offer.status = 'offered'
              AND existing_offer.expires_at > NOW()

              AND existing_offer.offered_starts_at <
                    sc.offered_ends_at

              AND existing_offer.offered_ends_at >
                    sc.offered_starts_at
        ) AS has_active_offer_conflict

    FROM slot_context sc
),

eligible_candidate AS (
    SELECT
        waitlist.id AS waitlist_id,
        waitlist.clinic_id,
        waitlist.doctor_id,
        waitlist.patient_id,
        waitlist.service_id,
        waitlist.original_appointment_id,
        waitlist.disruption_case_id,
        waitlist.priority,
        waitlist.created_at AS waitlist_created_at,

        patient.full_name AS patient_name,
        patient.mobile,

        ss.clinic_name,
        ss.doctor_name,
        ss.service_name,
        ss.timezone,
        ss.offered_starts_at,
        ss.offered_ends_at,
        ss.offer_expiry_minutes,
        ss.source

    FROM appointment_waitlist waitlist

    INNER JOIN slot_state ss
        ON ss.clinic_id = waitlist.clinic_id
       AND ss.doctor_id = waitlist.doctor_id
       AND ss.service_id = waitlist.service_id

    INNER JOIN patients patient
        ON patient.id = waitlist.patient_id

    WHERE waitlist.status = 'active'

      AND ss.is_in_past = FALSE
      AND ss.is_blocked = FALSE
      AND ss.has_appointment_conflict = FALSE
      AND ss.has_active_offer_conflict = FALSE

      AND (
            waitlist.desired_from IS NULL
            OR waitlist.desired_from <=
               ss.offered_starts_at
      )

      AND (
            waitlist.desired_to IS NULL
            OR waitlist.desired_to >=
               ss.offered_ends_at
      )

      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM appointment_waitlist_offers patient_offer

          WHERE patient_offer.waitlist_id =
                waitlist.id

            AND patient_offer.status = 'offered'
            AND patient_offer.expires_at > NOW()
      )

    ORDER BY
        waitlist.priority ASC,
        waitlist.created_at ASC,
        waitlist.id ASC

    FOR UPDATE OF waitlist SKIP LOCKED

    LIMIT 1
),

inserted_offer AS (
    INSERT INTO appointment_waitlist_offers (
        waitlist_id,
        doctor_id,
        offer_token,

        offered_starts_at,
        offered_ends_at,

        status,
        offered_at,
        expires_at,

        source
    )

    SELECT
        candidate.waitlist_id,
        candidate.doctor_id,

        MD5(
            RANDOM()::TEXT
            || CLOCK_TIMESTAMP()::TEXT
            || candidate.waitlist_id::TEXT
            || candidate.offered_starts_at::TEXT
        ),

        candidate.offered_starts_at,
        candidate.offered_ends_at,

        'offered',
        NOW(),

        NOW()
        + MAKE_INTERVAL(
            mins =>
                candidate.offer_expiry_minutes
        ),

        candidate.source

    FROM eligible_candidate candidate

    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

    RETURNING
        id AS offer_id,
        waitlist_id,
        doctor_id,
        offer_token,

        offered_starts_at,
        offered_ends_at,

        status AS offer_status,
        offered_at,
        expires_at,
        source
),

updated_waitlist AS (
    UPDATE appointment_waitlist waitlist

    SET
        status = 'offered',
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM inserted_offer offer

    WHERE waitlist.id = offer.waitlist_id
      AND waitlist.status = 'active'

    RETURNING
        waitlist.id AS waitlist_id,
        waitlist.status AS waitlist_status
),

offer_details AS (
    SELECT
        offer.offer_id,
        offer.offer_token,
        offer.offer_status,
        offer.offered_at,
        offer.expires_at,

        candidate.waitlist_id,
        candidate.patient_id,
        candidate.patient_name,
        candidate.mobile,

        candidate.clinic_name,
        candidate.doctor_name,
        candidate.service_name,
        candidate.timezone,

        candidate.original_appointment_id,
        candidate.disruption_case_id,
        candidate.priority,

        offer.offered_starts_at,
        offer.offered_ends_at

    FROM inserted_offer offer

    INNER JOIN eligible_candidate candidate
        ON candidate.waitlist_id =
           offer.waitlist_id

    INNER JOIN updated_waitlist updated
        ON updated.waitlist_id =
           offer.waitlist_id
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM slot_context
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN (
            SELECT is_in_past
            FROM slot_state
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN (
            SELECT is_blocked
            FROM slot_state
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN (
            SELECT has_appointment_conflict
            FROM slot_state
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN (
            SELECT has_active_offer_conflict
            FROM slot_state
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM eligible_candidate
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM offer_details
        )
            THEN TRUE

        ELSE FALSE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM slot_context
        )
            THEN 'invalid_target_slot'

        WHEN (
            SELECT is_in_past
            FROM slot_state
        )
            THEN 'target_time_in_past'

        WHEN (
            SELECT is_blocked
            FROM slot_state
        )
            THEN 'target_time_blocked'

        WHEN (
            SELECT has_appointment_conflict
            FROM slot_state
        )
            THEN 'slot_unavailable'

        WHEN (
            SELECT has_active_offer_conflict
            FROM slot_state
        )
            THEN 'slot_already_offered'

        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM eligible_candidate
        )
            THEN 'no_eligible_waitlist_patient'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM offer_details
        )
            THEN 'waitlist_offer_created'

        ELSE 'offer_creation_conflict'
    END AS result,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM slot_context
        )
            THEN 'زمان واردشده با برنامه کاری پزشک و خدمت انتخاب‌شده تطابق ندارد.'

        WHEN (
            SELECT is_in_past
            FROM slot_state
        )
            THEN 'زمان پیشنهادی باید مربوط به آینده باشد.'

        WHEN (
            SELECT is_blocked
            FROM slot_state
        )
            THEN 'این زمان در برنامه پزشک مسدود شده است.'

        WHEN (
            SELECT has_appointment_conflict
            FROM slot_state
        )
            THEN 'این زمان توسط یک نوبت فعال اشغال شده است.'

        WHEN (
            SELECT has_active_offer_conflict
            FROM slot_state
        )
            THEN 'این زمان در حال حاضر به بیمار دیگری پیشنهاد شده است.'

        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM eligible_candidate
        )
            THEN 'بیمار واجد شرایطی در لیست انتظار برای این پزشک، خدمت و زمان پیدا نشد.'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM offer_details
        )
            THEN 'زمان آزاد به اولین بیمار واجد شرایط در لیست انتظار پیشنهاد شد.'

        ELSE 'در فاصله انتخاب بیمار تا ثبت پیشنهاد، وضعیت لیست انتظار یا زمان تغییر کرد.'
    END AS message,

    r.clinic_name,
    r.doctor_name,
    r.service_name,
    r.target_date,
    r.start_time,

    (
        SELECT offer_id
        FROM offer_details
    ) AS offer_id,

    (
        SELECT offer_token
        FROM offer_details
    ) AS offer_token,

    (
        SELECT waitlist_id
        FROM offer_details
    ) AS waitlist_id,

    (
        SELECT patient_id
        FROM offer_details
    ) AS patient_id,

    (
        SELECT patient_name
        FROM offer_details
    ) AS patient_name,

    (
        SELECT mobile
        FROM offer_details
    ) AS mobile,

    (
        SELECT original_appointment_id
        FROM offer_details
    ) AS original_appointment_id,

    (
        SELECT disruption_case_id
        FROM offer_details
    ) AS disruption_case_id,

    (
        SELECT priority
        FROM offer_details
    ) AS waitlist_priority,

    (
        SELECT TO_CHAR(
            offered_starts_at
            AT TIME ZONE timezone,
            'YYYY-MM-DD'
        )
        FROM offer_details
    ) AS offered_date,

    (
        SELECT TO_CHAR(
            offered_starts_at
            AT TIME ZONE timezone,
            'HH24:MI'
        )
        FROM offer_details
    ) AS offered_start_time,

    (
        SELECT TO_CHAR(
            offered_ends_at
            AT TIME ZONE timezone,
            'HH24:MI'
        )
        FROM offer_details
    ) AS offered_end_time,

    (
        SELECT expires_at
        FROM offer_details
    ) AS offer_expires_at,

    r.offer_expiry_minutes,

    CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM offer_details
        )
            THEN 'send_offer_to_patient'
        ELSE 'none'
    END AS next_action

FROM request_data r;

parameters.content:
## پیشنهاد زمان آزاد به لیست انتظار

1. ابتدا Workflow شماره 22 را فقط یک‌بار اجرا کن.

2. یک زمان واقعاً آزاد را وارد کن؛ Workflow دوباره برنامه پزشک، بازه‌های مسدود و نوبت‌های موجود را کنترل می‌کند.

3. اولین بیمار واجد شرایط براساس `priority` و سپس زمان ورود به لیست انتخاب می‌شود.

4. این Workflow نوبت را ثبت نمی‌کند؛ فقط یک پیشنهاد زمان‌دار ایجاد می‌کند.

5. پاسخ بیمار در Workflow بعدی پردازش خواهد شد.
